protocol: Each revision uses the same four-point-light room, two 512-pixel local shadow maps, 30 fps editor cap, 720x464 drawing buffer and 1280x720 CSS viewport. Measure 30 seconds idle, then 30 seconds of real Details X commits cycling -2,-1,0,1,2 with a 500 ms pause after each. Edits continue for the whole window; faster hosts complete more inputs. Tracing/video off. Correctness pixel reads run separately.
qualification: Single local runs on Windows Chromium, not iPad Safari/PWA or thermal qualification. Engine end-frame intervals are a presentation proxy, not display timestamps. The original counter includes draw attempts that the fixed version can hold. CPU/copy values are synchronous elapsed times that can include driver waits. GPU readings are shared Engine diagnostics and are not used for a GPU performance claim. Resource churn is sampled every 250 ms and is a lower bound.

reproduction.script: pnpm --silent agent:wait local --script test:e2e -- e2e/rendering-baseline.spec.ts -g "scene viewport light-edit performance measurement"
reproduction.baseline: 225d55b8 production source plus the same measurement test and local performance configuration; isolated temporary worktree.

presentedIntervals.method: Engine end-frame time after this viewport copies a frame (older revisions use successful draws); not hardware display timestamps

sharedEngineGpu.method: Shared Engine diagnostic readings; may repeat the last completed query and include sibling views; not viewport GPU timing

resources.method: Estimated cache textures plus viewport geometry/shadows; incomplete resource accounting, not measured GPU residency. Sampled every 250 ms plus boundaries; churn is an observed lower bound and misses objects created/released between samples.
